boston.s1_head: Kitting the events trade of Boston
s1loc: Boston runs a live calendar under the shadow of the Stump, the great tower of St Botolph's church. The Blackfriars Theatre and Arts Centre on Spain Lane is one of the oldest working theatre buildings in the country, programming touring drama, live music, comedy and the One Act Drama Festival, with the Boston Playgoers and BOS Musical Theatre Group resident. Out at Central Park, the council builds a summer season of free outdoor events and the Boston Big Weekend around its arena and music stage.

And the trade runs at every size. The Blackfriars team, Central Park event operators and touring production companies run large seasonal crews and buy through procurement, while independent event crews, promoters and entertainers across Boston and the wider Lincolnshire fens need only a few branded pieces. A workwear supplier here has to serve the big festival weekend and the single crew alike, which is why we run trade accounts and direct online ordering side by side, front-of-house and stage crew both kitted.
